output.question: Who is Cisco's CTO?
output.answer: Cisco's CTO is Tom Gillis, who also holds the title of Senior Vice President. Cisco says he drives the company's vision for systems-level platform innovation. [Cisco executive profile](https://newsroom.cisco.com/c/r/newsroom/en/us/executives/tom-gillis.html)

key_facts.fact: Tom Gillis is Cisco's Chief Technology Officer and Senior Vice President.
In his CTO role, Tom Gillis drives Cisco's vision for systems-level platform innovation.

passages.quote: Tom Gillis is the Chief Technology Officer at Cisco, where he drives the company’s vision for systems-level platform innovation.

caveats: The official Cisco executive profile identifies Tom Gillis in the CTO role but does not display a publication or update date; the answer is current as of 2026-11-11 based on the page accessed.
Cisco's page uses the title 'Chief Technology Officer' without specifying a separate corporate-level CTO scope beyond the role description provided.
